type: PROPOSED APP FEATURE — not implemented, not read by the app
problem: Several Missouri rivers continue into Arkansas below the last Missouri access; a section that ends in another state cannot be expressed in one state's catalog.
proposal: Allow a section endpoint to reference another state's registry (e.g. {state: 'AR', point: '<name>'}) once that state's package exists.
notDone: No Arkansas points were researched or added; no cross-state sections are in the catalog. Mississippi and Missouri River border reaches (IL, KS, NE) are not covered.

references.proposedSection: Myrtle Access (MO) → first public Eleven Point access in Arkansas (to be researched with the AR package)
references.note: Myrtle is the last Missouri access on the Eleven Point, about 1 mile above the Arkansas line.

references.proposedSection: Coon Island CA (MO) → first public Black River access in Arkansas
references.note: Southern-most Missouri Black River ramp; the river continues into Arkansas.

references.moEndpointName: St. Francis River below Wappapello Lake
references.note: Informational only: the catalogued St. Francis reach is the upper whitewater/float reach above Wappapello Lake; below the dam the river forms the MO–AR border. No section proposed.
